html.finalText:
I added a pricing section and an FAQ section below Features, and lint found no issues.

- **Pricing:** A heading sits above three cards: Free at $0, Pro at $19 and Team at $49. Each card has three bullet features and a button. The Pro card has a primary-colour border, a shadow, a "Recommended" badge and the primary button. The cards stack on mobile and sit in three columns from the md breakpoint.
- **FAQ:** A heading sits above four question-and-answer items, each separated by a thin divider.

I wrote the prices, feature lists and FAQ answers as placeholder copy, so check them against your real offering.

props.text: Can I try it before paying?
Yes. The Free plan has no time limit, so you can build up to three projects before upgrading.
Anytime. Upgrades apply immediately and downgrades take effect at the end of your billing period.
Does the exported code match my design?
Yes. Frames are real DOM, and exports use your design tokens and components, so the code mirrors the canvas.
Team is billed per seat each month. Add or remove teammates whenever you like and we prorate the difference.
